title: HOWLER LANDING CIRCLE SHOWS THE REAL BLAST
why: The Howler shell's red landing circle was drawn squashed: as wide as the blast but only six tenths as tall. The world is drawn true to scale (the frag marker and the air strike rings are round) and the shell hurts everyone within the same distance in every direction, so a man a bit north or south of the aim point stood outside the drawn circle and still got hit. Proven in the cloud: a man 75 south of the aim point, outside the drawn circle, lost health just like a man 75 east, who was inside it; the circle's outline was 90 wide but 54 tall. Now the filling disc, the faint full outline and the growing ring are drawn round; size, colour, fade and fill timing are unchanged. Next playtest: the Howler circle will look taller than before, the same width, and now shows exactly where the shell hurts.
now: The Howler landing circle is now round and shows exactly where the shell hurts; before it was squashed and men just above or below it still got hit.
